reviews.name: Mr. Rudra
reviews.text: When my father fell critically ill, a friend suggested I connect with Rekhaji for an Akashic reading. I was sceptical but desperate. What I experienced was beyond words: things so accurate, so personal, that I had no explanation. I followed every piece of her guidance with faith. And then something we were all praying for happened. My father survived.
